name: Flat-vector space (Hermes /kurzgesagt)
description: Deep navy space with twinkling stars, flat planets lit from one side and bright rounded label tags, one white caption low in the frame. Hermes renders it with /kurzgesagt.

cautions: Research only: a Hermes render is never published.
Hermes renders with the claude-animation-skills skill installed there; record what it used.
Check every number: this look reads as authoritative, so a wrong fact is worse here than anywhere.
One idea per shot, no paragraphs on screen.
Not affiliated with Kurzgesagt; never copy their characters (the birds) or artwork.

curation.notes: Evidence for trial of a hermes pack (there is no Hermes in CI, so no CI render exists or is claimed). The skill is in the source repository at the pinned commit and the owner reports it works in Hermes. Every portal run of this pack is a research trial, never published.

hermes.input: One clip per storyboard shot, in shot order. For each shot, write the skill's JSON spec from the shot's onScreenText (else its description) and the run's topic, following the skill's spec and taste rules (lines (1 to 3 captions: a two-part question and the answer at the payoff), tag (under about 18 characters); another topic copies the template in the same style); never invent data the storyboard does not give. Render each spec with the skill, fit each clip to the shot's seconds (hold the last frame when the shot is longer, play it faster when shorter), cut them together, add the run's narration as the audio and burn the run's captions in the caption band. The shot pictures are not needed by this skill; ignore them.
hermes.output: One 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 at 30 fps with the narration, published under /clip/ on the media host. The studio then runs qc-video and the owner scores it on Review.
